'''Nira Sivrak''' was a [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] and the partner of [[Tagg Sivrak]]. Their [[Tagg and Nira Sivrak's child|child]], whose uncle was [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Lak Sivrak/Legends|Lak Sivrak]], studied at the [[University of Coruscant/Legends|University of Coruscant]].<ref name="EGTAS" />
